name: Motto Ijitte Princess ~Mou! Mata Konna Tokoro de 2~
original_name: もっといじってプリンセス～もう！またこんなところで2～
source:
Prince lives a carefree life while king is occupied with grand politics. Three princesses are captured after conquering neighboring territories. King gets an idea to pacify nations by arranging a marriage between his son and one of captured princesses. But it's difficult to understand which one to choose without testing them properly.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
王子过着无忧无虑的生活，国王则忙于处理国家大事。邻国领土被征服后，三位公主沦为俘虏。国王想到一个安抚各国的办法：安排儿子迎娶其中一位公主。然而，如果不先对她们进行充分考察，又很难判断究竟该选谁。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
